text:
Cassie (CS): Weekly account health check-in for AcmeCorp — noticed a model mix shift after yesterday's canary rollout. Need a quick read: adoption % by model, fallback rate, latency delta, spend delta.

Marco (Solutions): Saw it too. New 'redwood-v2-small' adoption jumped ~22% of traffic in 12h. Fallbacks to 'redwood-v1' at 3.8% overall, but concentrated on longer prompts.

metrics-bot: Automated summary attached:
```
period: last 24h
total requests: 13.2k
redwood-v2-small: 22.4% (up 18pt)
redwood-v1: 60.1% (down 12pt)
fallbacks (any -> v1): 3.8% (esp >1024 tokens: 9.6%)
median latency (v2-small): 112ms (+32ms vs v1)
p95 latency (v2-small): 410ms (+120ms)
error rate (v2-small): 0.9% (mostly OOMs during 1 big spike)
estimate spend delta: +12% day-over-day
```

Anya (AE): Customer reported a couple of timeouts in prod at 15:40 PST, said "responses got truncated". They're asking for rollback plan if SLA hit.

Marco (Solutions): Suggest throttling long-context requests to v1 or enabling prefix KV cache for them. Can we set a temporary routing rule? @ops-bot can you add rule: route >1k tokens -> redwood-v1, until we stabilize?

ops-bot: @Marco rule queued: route_long_contexts_to_v1. Will deploy at 1768452200 (in ~2m). :gear:

Cassie (CS): I'll loop in account team, noting elevated spend and fallback risk. Action items:
- Marco: confirm rollback / routing deployed? 
- Metrics: monitor fallback rate per prompt-length, update every 30m
- Anya: prep customer note re: mitigation + ETA

Marco (Solutions): routing deployed. early signal: fallback rate down to 1.2% over last 10m. p95 latency for mixed traffic trending down.

Anya (AE): Thanks — sending customer note now. Also capturing feedback: prefer slower but consistent outputs vs occasional truncation.

Cassie (CS): Good. We'll re-run canary with adjusted batch config and KV cache tomorrow. Filing follow-up in CRM. :thumbsup:

metrics-bot: Next automated snapshot in 30m. End of thread.
